User Guide
Your typical journey
From a messy status report to a board-ready story — the everyday happy path through FastPPM.
1
Sign in
Land on the chat analyst that already knows every initiative, milestone, risk and value driver.
2
Ingest
Drag a status report, tracker or deck (PDF / XLSX / PPTX / DOCX) into Documents — the AI extracts the structure.
3
Review & merge
Check the before → after, then merge into the master repository in one click.
4
Track
Your initiative is now live in the registry, Gantt and dashboard — one source of truth.
5
Ask & update
Ask the copilot for status, risk and value — and give updates in plain English, with an audit trail.
6
Report
Generate a board-ready report from a template, edit it block-by-block, and export to PDF / DOCX / PPTX.

FastPPM · User Guide2 / 17
1 · Ask FastPPM
  • The home screen is a chat analyst that knows all your data.
  • “What's the overall status of the Value Creation Plan?”
  • “Which initiatives are red or at risk, and why?”
  • “Show me the top value drivers by realised benefit.”
  • Give updates in plain English — applied with an audit entry:
  • “Mark Design / baseline as 80% complete.” · “Set ERP modernisation to at risk.”
FastPPM · User Guide3 / 17
2 · Ingest documents (flagship)
Upload▶Extract▶ Review▶Merge
  • Drag & drop PDF / XLSX / PPTX / DOCX status reports, trackers and decks.
  • The AI extracts milestones, risks and value drivers, normalising varied column names and date formats, and flags inconsistencies.
  • Review the extracted entities, then Merge into master repository —
  • it appears as an initiative in the registry, Gantt and dashboard, searchable from chat.
FastPPM · User Guide4 / 17
Ask FastPPM — in action
The chat analyst answers status, value and risk questions over your live data — and applies natural-language updates.
FastPPM · User Guide5 / 17
Charts on demand
Ask for stats▶Table▶ Pick a chart▶Chart
  • Ask a quantitative question — “value realised by category?”, “how many initiatives are red?”, “show the value trend”.
  • FastPPM answers with a table of the real numbers, then offers chart chips — Bar, Pie or Line — with the best one highlighted.
  • Click a chip and the interactive chart draws inline; switch type any time. Time series default to a line, comparisons to a bar, parts-of-whole to a pie.
